# Scopes inside procedures
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language#create_procedure
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_procedures and procedures and tables of its own. The
# dataset stays in the project after the scripts run. BigQuery has answered that a procedure sets
# @@dataset_id for the whole script; these ask what else follows from it.

# Whether a procedure resolves unqualified table names against the @@dataset_id it sets. The
# emulator resolves them against no default dataset, as it does for the caller's @@dataset_id.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_procedures.t AS SELECT 1 AS n;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.set_dataset_tables() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_procedures'; SELECT n FROM t; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.set_dataset_tables()
?>

# Whether a procedure sets @@dataset_project_id for the whole script. The emulator rejects the
# assignment in procedures until this settles.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.set_dataset_project() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SET @@dataset_project_id = 'example-project'; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.set_dataset_project();
SELECT @@dataset_project_id
?>
